enchantments.tooltip: Proof Against Poison +6: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +6 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 7 + their Fortitude save).
Exceptional Charisma +1: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +1 Exceptional bonus to Charisma.
